about: Small bodies flagged notable in the Solar System catalogues (format flag 1: shown whatever the Detail cut, design 7.3). Authored list: bodies a spacecraft has flown past, orbited or landed on, and named comets people expect. Names are JPL's own (JPL names 9P, 81P and 103P without the number). The build checks each designation's name against JPL's row and fails on a mismatch, so a wrong designation cannot slip in. Moons are not listed: every moon with a size is in base-sol or the moon files, and Phobos and Deimos are base-sol bodies.

small_bodies.name: Ida
small_bodies.why: flown past by Galileo; first asteroid moon found (Dactyl)

small_bodies.name: Eros
small_bodies.why: orbited and landed on by NEAR Shoemaker

small_bodies.name: Halley
small_bodies.why: flown past by Giotto and the Vega probes; the best-known comet

small_bodies.name: Churyumov-Gerasimenko
small_bodies.why: orbited and landed on by Rosetta and Philae
